== Objectives ==
Slay 12 Gor'dosh Brutes, 8 Gor'dosh Ogres, and 5 Gor'dosh Shamans for Sergeant Blackwell in Caelan's Rest.
* [[Gor'dosh Brute]] (12)
* [[Gor'dosh Ogre]] (8)
* [[Gor'dosh Shaman]] (5)

== Description ==
The Gor'dosh Ogres are a fearsome foe. They battled us almost constantly when we made landfall, but we drove them back. It is only a matter of time before they are ready to strike again.

Now that they are allied with Lapidis, they have become even bolder upon the island and must be stopped at any and all costs. They have established quite a formidable force to the northwest in an area known as Gor'dosh Heights. Travel there and kill them to end the bloodshed.

==Rewards==
* 4900 [[XP]]

== Progress ==
Brutality, that is all they know, and that is all they shall receive.

== Completion ==
With their numbers thinned, it will take them much longer to organize an attack. Your actions have helped us greatly, but still, there is more to be done.
